description: Ertrian faction — economy bonus, factories vs airports, ranged doctrine.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Ertrian economy Ertrians thrive on trade routes secured by BISMUTH.◦ You earn a 10% bonus on structure income compared to the baseline — snowball map control into a stronger wallet.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Factories and airports ◦ Factories train ground forces — your core capture and front-line toolkit. ◦ Airports recruit flyers that bypass terrain and threaten exposed targets.Choose production buildings to match the map: chokepoints vs open flanks.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Ranged units (Ertrian specialty) ◦ Ranged units strike from a distance but cannot move and shoot in the same turn — plan the tempo of your turns.◦ Blue tiles show movement; red outlines show attack range.◦ Screen fragile capture units, then delete defenders before they reach your line.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Summary Ertrians reward aggressive map control: ranged firepower plus bonus income from every secured BISMUTH node.
